scope: we examined how such proteins partition into soluble urine (SU) and urinary pellet (UP) fractions by analyzing 33 urine specimens
The UP and SU were obtained.
The SU fraction was concentrated in an Amicon Ultra-15 centrifugal filter (10 kDa MWCO, Millipore) at 3000 × rpm, and a volume of ~ 1.0 mL was retained.

The UP fraction was treated with an 8 M urea buffer, and protein concentrations were estimated using the Bradford assay or SDS-PAGE as described.
